title: Health Check Pattern: Expose Liveness and Readiness Probes
title_es: Patrón Health Check: Sondeos de Liveness y Readiness
description: Runnable FastAPI demo with /health/live, /health/ready and /health/startup endpoints, dependency checks with timeouts, graceful shutdown via lifespan, a Kubernetes deployment with all three probe types, and a docker-compose lab with PostgreSQL and Redis.
description_es: Demo ejecutable en FastAPI con endpoints /health/live, /health/ready y /health/startup, chequeos de dependencias con timeouts, apagado elegante con lifespan, un Deployment de Kubernetes con los tres tipos de probe y un laboratorio docker-compose con PostgreSQL y Redis.
